ada:sampleFormAnalyticalSubstrateDefault: In situ — polished thin section (two-volume cell)
ada:laserManufacturerModel: New Wave Research NWR FemtoUC (Yb:KGW fs, 257 nm PHAROS amplifier)
ada:interfaceConeConfiguration: X skimmer cone + Jet sample cone (high-sensitivity configuration)
ada:detectorConfiguration: Seven fixed electron multiplier ICs + nine Faraday cups (1011 Ω resistors)
ada:laserWavelengthAndType: 257 nm Yb:KGW femtosecond; pulse duration 300 fs (PHAROS system)
ada:ablationCellType: Two-volume cell (constant distance between laser and aerosol extraction)
ada:laserSpotPathAblationMode: Transect (continuous line scan at 2–6 µm s⁻¹)
ada:laserFluenceDefault: ~60% of maximum output (PHAROS system; exact J cm⁻² not converted)
ada:laserRepetitionRateDefault: 10–30 Hz (varied based on Sr concentration in samples)
ada:analysisSequenceDefault: 14 reference glasses analyzed to evaluate accuracy and provide calibration factors; natural minerals as unknowns for data quality evaluation; 1 block of 120 cycles per analysis
ada:backgroundCountTimeDefault: 30 cycles × 0.524 s ≈ 15.7 s (first 30 cycles of the 120-cycle block with no laser ablation)
ada:integrationTimePerCycleDefault: 0.524 s integration time per cycle (one block of 120 cycles = 62.88 s total)
ada:internalStandardApproach: No conventional IS; external calibration only (Rb/Sr elemental fractionation corrected by series of reference glasses; 87Sr/86Sr mass bias corrected by exponential law using 88Sr/86Sr = 8.37521)
ada:internalStandardElement: No conventional IS; ⁸⁵Rb used to calculate ⁸⁷Rb/⁸⁶Sr via 87Rb/85Rb; external calibration for Rb/Sr elemental fractionation using reference glasses
ada:elementalFractionationCorrection: Femtosecond laser substantially reduces elemental fractionation; no explicit downhole correction; Rb/Sr elemental fractionation corrected externally by analyzing series of reference glasses; exponential law for Sr isotope mass bias (88Sr/86Sr = 8.37521)
ada:signalIntegrationIntervalMethod: Regions of integration for gas background and sample signal selected first; cycles at beginning and end of ablation discarded; for heterogeneous minerals (unstable 87Rb/86Sr): SUIA (Smallest Unit Isochron Age) data reduction strategy applied per cycle
ada:blankBackgroundCorrectionMethod: First 30 cycles (no laser ablation) used for background collection; background Kr⁺ signals removed by correction; no additional Kr peak stripping applied
ada:isobaricInterferenceCorrectionsAppli: Yes — correction for doubly charged ions: ¹⁶⁸Er²⁺ on ⁸⁴Sr; ¹⁷⁰Er²⁺ and ¹⁷⁰Yb²⁺ on ⁸⁵Rb; ¹⁷²Yb²⁺ on ⁸⁶Sr; ¹⁷⁴Yb²⁺ on ⁸⁷Sr; ⁸⁷Rb isobaric on ⁸⁷Sr (corrected using 85Rb signal and exponential law)
ada:interferingSpecies: ¹⁶⁸Er²⁺ on ⁸⁴Sr; ¹⁷⁰Er²⁺ + ¹⁷⁰Yb²⁺ on ⁸⁵Rb; ¹⁷²Yb²⁺ on ⁸⁶Sr; ¹⁷⁴Yb²⁺ on ⁸⁷Sr; ⁸⁷Rb on ⁸⁷Sr (isobaric)
ada:interferenceCorrectionMethod: Sequential interference correction: (a) doubly charged Er and Yb corrections on Sr masses using measured 167Er²⁺ and 173Yb²⁺ signals and natural isotope ratios; (b) 87Rb isobaric correction on 87Sr using measured 85Rb signal and user-specified 87Rb/85Rb calculated from exponential law for mass bias
ada:primaryCalibrationStandardNameDefaul: NIST 610 for instrument parameter optimization; series of reference glasses (NIST 612, BHVO-2G, BCR-2G, NKT-1G, TB-1G, ATHO-G, KL2-G, ML3B-G, StHs6/80-G, T1-G) for external calibration of ⁸⁷Rb/⁸⁶Sr ratio; natural clinopyroxenes (NHB-9, YY12-01) and anorthite (YG4301) as unknown samples for ⁸⁷Sr/⁸⁶Sr data quality evaluation
ada:secondaryReferenceMaterialsDefault: Natural clinopyroxenes NHB-9 and YY12-01 (reference values given in Table 2); anorthite YG4301 — measured as unknowns for 87Sr/86Sr data quality evaluation
ada:withinSessionAnalyticalPrecisionAndA: Standard error (USE = SE at 95% confidence) for 87Sr/86Sr and 87Rb/86Sr per individual run; dependent on signal intensity (regression shown in Fig. 3); relative errors for 87Rb/86Sr: ±3% for most reference glasses; 87Sr/86Sr relative errors: <0.2‰ for materials with 87Rb/86Sr <1
ada:analyticalAccuracyAndAssessmentMetho: 87Sr/86Sr relative errors <0.2‰ for reference materials with 87Rb/86Sr <1 (12 of 14 reference materials); 87Rb/86Sr relative accuracy within ±3% for 11 glasses; exceptions: NIST 610 (−2.97%), NIST 612 (+2.02%), ATHO-G (+2.89%) — all within stated ±3% criterion

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Signal Smoothing
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Signal-smoothing device used downstream from ablation cell (model not specified); significantly reduced short-term signal variability

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Cycles with 87Rb/86Sr >1 deleted (invalid Rb interference correction); cycles with 88Sr signal <0.2 V discarded (poor precision); SUIA method applied to heterogeneous minerals

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: 2–6 µm s⁻¹ (varied based on Sr concentration in target minerals)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Plasma / Make-up Gas Addition
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Ar make-up (flow rate not separately stated); N₂ 12 ml min⁻¹ added via Y-connector downstream of signal-smoothing device

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Uncertainty Propagation Method
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Standard error (SE = SD/√n) for repeatability within individual runs; assessed separately for 87Sr/86Sr and 87Rb/86Sr using signal intensity regression

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Multi-Run Sequential Analysis Design
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Single line scan per location (1 block of 120 cycles at 0.524 s integration)
